 Win a trip to Hong Kong Disneyland at OPPO’s 11.11 Sale
 If you can win a trip to Hong Kong Disneyland at OPPO’s 11.11 Sale, you should probably start browsing!
 By Carlos Franco - November 9, 2026 OPPO is officially kicking off the tech holiday shopping season in the Philippines with their seasonal OPPO 11.11 Sale. The sale  offers savings of up to Php 8,000, exclusive freebies, and a chance to win a trip to Hong Kong Disneyland. Running across OPPO’s official online stores on Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop through November 13, 2026, the promotion anchors the brand’s nationwide Maligayang PaskOPPO Christmas campaign.
 Under the 11.11 promotional sale, shoppers can score price drops spanning smartphones, tablets, and audio accessories. Featured discounts across participating platforms include Php 1,000 off the OPPO Enco Air5 and Reno15 5G, Php 4,000 off the flagship OPPO Find X9, and up to Php 8,000 off the OPPO Reno16 Series. Select purchases also come paired with exclusive bundled gifts, such as a free 10,000mAh power bank with the Reno16 and Reno15 Series, a free protective case with the OPPO Pad SE, and free Tango Jet Earbuds valued at Php 1,699 with the OPPO A7 Pro 5G.
 Adding to the festive excitement, shoppers can participate in the Maligayang PaskOPPO Digital Caroling Pass by pre-registering online, linking their new device to the My OPPO App, and sharing a holiday moment. Completing these steps grants entries into the Grand Raffle draw on January 31, 2027, where two lucky grand prize winners will each receive a five-day, four-night Hong Kong Disneyland package worth Php 500,000. A total of 1,277 lucky winners will take home prizes including smartphones, wireless earbuds, shavers, SMAC points, and digital vouchers.
 From November 1-10, OPPO’s ‘Shop to Win’ early raffle gives 11 lucky winners a chance to receive a travel luggage for their adventures ahead. From a long-awaited homecoming to a spontaneous weekend escape, imagine packing your new device alongside your holiday essentials and setting off to make new memories. Here’s how to join:
 Customers will earn one (1) raffle entry for every purchase of any OPPO device made through the OPPO Official Store on  Shopee , Lazada , and TikTok Shop .
 The promo period runs from November 1, 2026, at 12:00 AM to November 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM.
 Eleven (11) winners will each receive one (1) travel luggage.
 The raffle draw will be held on November 27, 2026. Winners will be contacted via Shopee, Lazada, or TikTok Shop Chat and provided with instructions on how to claim their prizes.
 Start your holiday shopping with OPPO and let the season’s surprises unfold. For more information on the 11.11 Sale and Christmas campaign, visit www.oppo.com/ph/ and OPPO Philippines’ official Facebook page.
